item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

Researchers quantified the response of 23K Glacier and 24K Glacier.

item.title: OMB NASA budget proposal: administrative omission as mission termination
item.description:
The White House Office of Management and Budget (OMB) NASA budget proposal introduces a mechanism of cancellation through omission.
The OMB cover letter for the request states that it terminates over 40 missions, yet the document does not explicitly name them. Instead, the proposal omits specific missions that were part of last year's failed request. This creates a lack of transparency in a document that is typically detailed. item.title: CNN model for IceCube DeepCore flavor and inelasticity reconstruction
item.description:
The IceCube DeepCore extension is designed to measure GeV scale atmospheric neutrino interactions. The signal arriving at the detector is a sparse collection of photons, a record of an event that has already concluded.
In the paper arXiv:2307.16373, J. H. Peterson, M. Prado Rodriguez, and K. Hanson present a 2D convolutional neural network (CNN) model for event reconstruction. The model is built to exploit time and depth translational symmetry within the sparse instrumentation data of DeepCore.
